user.title: Jarolift RF
user.description: Set up a new installation, or take over an existing ESP32-Jarolift-Controller.

manual.title: New installation
manual.description: Enter the Jarolift master keys. Leave the serial empty to generate a new one; every motor then has to be learned (button or action 'Learn').

data_description.bridge_service: ESPHome device running the jarolift-bridge package (action DEVICE_send_raw).
data_description.base_serial: Optional. 20 bit (max 0xFFFFF). Empty = generate a new serial.
data_description.channel_names: One name per line; line 1 = channel 1. More channels can be added later.
data_description.counter_start: 1 for a new serial. When reusing a serial: last counter of the old sender + 16.
data_description.legacy_learn: Only for very old receivers. The old controller always used the new mode.
data_description.tx_enabled: Leave off for a receive-only first test. Nothing is sent while off.

import_config.title: Import from ESP32-Jarolift-Controller (config.json)
import_config.description: Paste the config.json of the original ESP32-Jarolift-Controller to take over keys, serial, channels and groups, or enter keys and serial manually. Keys are stored only in Home Assistant and never logged.

data_description.bridge_service: ESPHome device running the jarolift-bridge package (action DEVICE_send_raw).
data_description.config_json: Only keys, serial, channels and groups are read; the text itself is not stored.
data_description.master_msb: Decimal, or hexadecimal with 0x prefix. Leave empty to take it from config.json.
data_description.master_lsb: Decimal, or hexadecimal with 0x prefix. Leave empty to take it from config.json.
data_description.base_serial: 20 bit (max 0xFFFFF). Decimal or 0x… Leave empty to take it from config.json.
data_description.counter_start: Device counter of the old controller + 16 (safety margin). Can only move forward later.
data_description.legacy_learn: Only for very old receivers. The old controller always used the new mode.
data_description.tx_enabled: Leave off for a receive-only first test. Nothing is sent while off.

import_summary.title: Import from config.json

reconfigure.title: Change connection and keys
reconfigure.description: Current: bridge {bridge}, serial {serial}, next counter {counter}. Keys are not shown. Leave fields empty to keep the stored values.

data_description.base_serial: Empty = keep. A new serial is a new sender: every motor must be learned again.
data_description.counter_start: Only needed together with a new serial (1 for a fresh serial).

error.invalid_key: Invalid key (32 bit, not both zero).

abort.no_bridge: No ESPHome device with a send_raw action found. Flash the jarolift-bridge package first and add the device to Home Assistant.
abort.already_configured: This serial number is already configured.

data_description.tx_enabled: Leave off for a receive-only first test. Nothing is sent while off.
data_description.tx_power_dbm: The old controller effectively sent with about 0 dBm.
data_description.bundle_ms: Identical commands within this time are sent as one group telegram. 0 = off.
data_description.legacy_learn: Only for very old receivers. The old controller always used the new mode.

reconfigure.title: Edit channel
reconfigure.description: Changing the channel number means the motor must be learned on the new channel; groups refer to channel numbers.

user.title: Add remote
user.description: Press a button on the remote shortly before opening this dialog; it then appears in the list. Or enter its serial manually.

data_description.source: Recently received unknown remotes (time, button, its channel mask; check mark = cryptographically verified).
data_description.remote_serial: As 'remote_serial' in the old config.json (decimal or 0x).
data_description.channels: Their state is updated when the remote is used.
Their state is updated when the remote is used.

learn.name: Learn
learn.description: Teach this channel to a motor in learn mode.

unlearn.name: Unlearn
unlearn.description: Remove this channel from the motor.

set_endpoint.name: Set end point
set_endpoint.description: Store the current position as upper or lower end point.

delete_endpoint.name: Delete end point
delete_endpoint.description: Delete the upper or lower end point.

set_shade.name: Save shade position
set_shade.description: Store the current position as shade position.

shade.name: Drive to shade position
shade.description: Drive channels or groups to the stored shade position.

set_counter.name: Set counter
set_counter.description: Move the rolling-code counter forward (never backwards).

counter_high.title: Jarolift counter almost exhausted
counter_high.description: The next rolling-code counter value is {next} of 65535. Before it runs out, set up a new serial number and learn all motors again.

entity_id_blocked.title: Old entities block Jarolift entity IDs

foreign_sender.title: Another sender uses this serial number
foreign_sender.description: A telegram with this integration's own serial number was received. Usually the old controller is still running. Two senders with one serial and separate counters cause missed commands: switch the old controller off (or remove its CC1101).

counter_exhausted.message: The rolling-code counter is exhausted (65535). New serial and re-learning required.

stopping.message: Home Assistant is stopping; nothing is sent.

counter_write_failed.message: Counter could not be saved; nothing was sent.

bridge_timeout.message: Radio bridge did not confirm the transmission.

tx_disabled.message: Transmitting is disabled in the integration options.

command_too_old.message: Command dropped: waited too long in the queue.

channel_required.message: {entity_id} is a group; this action needs single channels.

entry_not_loaded.message: Jarolift RF entry not found or not loaded.

counter_backwards.message: The counter can only move forward (current: {current}).
